title: Station Eleven
author: Emily St. John Mandel
current_text: Station Eleven was banned from a school library in TN in 2024 after a governmental decision-maker requested censorship, citing claims of illegal obscenity for minors, LGBTQIA+ representation, and EDI content.

sources.quote:
Station Eleven
Mandel, Emily St. John, 1979-
Banned from a school library in TN in 2024 when a governmental decision-maker requested censorship on the basis of false claims of illegal obscenity for minors, LGBTQIA+ representation, and EDI content.
